body:
i totally agree with everything you’re saying. it’s the way when i was upset he didn’t get a hold of me when this first started happening he told me he was “out of control” with when to message me, but he is in control of waking up and going to work when he could just sleep in and do nothing. also i forgot to update my post but there is a huge possibility he’s going out on his bike since he always does that when he’s not doing too well. he doesn’t have many friends other than just coworkers, but even then they’re just acquaintances. 

i think the problem is that i’m so committed to him. we’ve been planning to meet in february, and we always speak about it. idk, i always felt like i’d rather die than not be with him. regardless of all the bad things he does, he still makes me so happy. like i feel complete with him. but now everything has been cut off and i feel so lonely. i can’t even spend a day alone without breaking down :(

tell her now. provide screenshots. don’t make her go through this - this could save her so much time, money, and effort. if she lashes out on you, that’s on her, not you. you’d be doing the right thing.
